opportunities.name: Flight Beam Lock
opportunities.objective: Count full-second bursts during moving flight.
opportunities.mechanic: Q bursts require a full second on one enemy. W removes Q cooldown/channel cap during flight; Rylai may retain the enemy, Cosmic assists movement and Seraph provides finite mana. Riftmaker rewards actual sustained combat.
opportunities.requiredState: Record Stardust, mana and a flight path allowing repeated full-second hits. Earn Seraph transformation through recorded Tear stacks before using this six-slot state.
opportunities.failure: Control interrupts Q or flight carries him away.
opportunities.test: Count full-second bursts during moving flight; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: 9999 channel duration does not mean infinite mana.

opportunities.name: Singularity Ally Window
opportunities.objective: Compare allied damage after R against E alone.
opportunities.mechanic: E drags and has a Stardust execute; R stuns or knocks up. Mandate explicitly requires immobilization, so use R as its trigger. Blackfire rewards enemies actually burned and Cryptbloom rewards a real confinement takedown.
opportunities.requiredState: Record enhanced R readiness and finite Stardust; allies hit the mark.
opportunities.failure: Targets leave E or allies cannot exploit R.
opportunities.test: Compare allied damage after R against E alone; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: An E drag or Rylai slow is not proven to trigger Mandate.

ruledOut.reason: Q is magic AP damage, not an ordinary attack.

unknowns: Stardust W/R area helpers are unresolved; enhanced R is conditional.
Unresolved conditional/runtime tooltip tokens prevent a complete numerical model; retained helpers do not establish live behavior.

testPlan: Required state: Record Stardust, mana and a flight path allowing repeated full-second hits. Earn Seraph transformation through recorded Tear stacks before using this six-slot state.
Count full-second bursts during moving flight; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Control interrupts Q or flight carries him away.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: 9999 channel duration does not mean infinite mana.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Cosmic Drive, Seraph's Embrace, Riftmaker, Rabadon's Deathcap, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
